title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Public Sector Consulting
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Analyst Roles</span></span></h3> <p>Our Analyst roles give you the opportunity to build a career in an award-winning management consultancy firm while contributing to meaningful client work from day one. You will develop an understanding of the consulting business model as well as hands-on experience across the consulting project lifecycle, from understanding client challenges and analysing evidence through to developing recommendations and supporting delivery.</p> <p>As an Analyst you will join a real consulting team, working and learning from experienced consultants, with exposure to meaningful client work alongside structured development to help you learn more about Baringa and working as a consultant.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">About the Government team at Baringa</span></span></h3> <p>Our Government team helps departments, agencies and public services solve complex problems and deliver better outcomes for citizens. Our work spans Central Government, Home Affairs, and Health and Public Infrastructure, from redesigning services and strengthening operations to using data, technology and AI to improve decisions and delivery.</p> <p>We work on Government’s most complex changes, partnering with departments across Whitehall and the wider public sector, using our skills in Strategy and Business Cases, Project Delivery, Operational Delivery, DDaT and Government Commercial.</p> <p>The UK public sector is navigating significant challenges and opportunities, including the delivery of major national priorities and missions. As our Public Sector team continues to grow, we are looking for curious and motivated Analysts who are excited to learn, contribute and develop with us. You do not need previous consulting or public sector experience – we are interested in how you approach problems, learn new things and apply your skills to real-world challenges.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">&nbsp;</span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>We will embed you in client projects as part of a consulting team, working alongside experienced consultants to learn while delivering real client outcomes. You will not be expected to know how to do all of this from day one. You will be supported throughout and given opportunities to build your skills through meaningful project work.</p> <p>Depending on the project you join, you may have the opportunity to:</p> <ul> <li>Analyse quantitative and qualitative information to identify insights, trends and opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Explore how data, digital technology, automation or AI could help improve public services.</li> <li>Develop recommendations and delivery plans, considering how people, technology and data work together.</li> <li>Support the development of client materials, including presentations, reports, workshop outputs and project updates.</li> <li>Contribute to meetings and workshop discussions, helping to capture key points, actions and decisions.</li> <li>Learn how consulting teams work together to solve problems, structure ambiguous challenges and communicate clearly with clients and colleagues.</li> </ul> <p>Examples of the type of projects you could be working on are:</p> <ul> <li>Support transformation projects that help government and public sector organisations improve services, strengthen operations and deliver better outcomes for citizens.</li> <li>Help review how services and processes work, from frontline delivery through to internal operations, identifying opportunities to make them simpler, more effective or more resilient.</li> <li>Contribute to digital, data and analytics work, including projects that use AI or data-led approaches to help clients make better decisions.</li> <li>Support the development of business cases and funding proposals, helping clients assess different options and make evidence-based decisions.</li> <li>Help design how services should operate, looking at how people, processes, technology and data come together to deliver better results within operating models and service blueprints.</li> <li>Support commercial and procurement activity, such as researching suppliers, comparing options and helping prepare materials for decision-making.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What are we looking for?</span></span></h3> <p>We welcome applications from students across a broad range of academic disciplines, including STEM and non-STEM subjects, and are particularly keen to hear from students who enjoy solving complex problems using evidence, data, technology and creative thinking. You do not need to have previous experience in consulting or the public sector - what matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in helping public sector organisations solve complex challenges.</p> <p>We are looking for people who are excited by the opportunity to learn how consulting teams work, contribute to meaningful client projects and develop their skills in a supportive environment. You may be a good fit if you bring:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Structured problem solving</strong>, with the ability to break down unfamiliar questions and identify what matters.</li> <li><strong>Data analysis skills</strong>, and comfort working with data to surface insight and support evidence-based recommendations.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Digital and AI literacy</strong>, with genuine curiosity about AI and its practical application, and a foundational understanding of how to use these tools responsibly and ethically.</li> <li><strong>Interest in policy, government and public service</strong>, and how national priorities translate into delivery on the ground.</li> <li><strong>Commercial and financial curiosity</strong>, with an interest in how money, value and delivery decisions shape public services, and comfort working with numbers to support them.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication skills</strong>, including the ability to explain ideas simply and structure your thinking in writing and conversation.</li> <li><strong>A collaborative approach</strong>, with enthusiasm for working in teams and learning from others.</li> <li><strong>Willingness to learn and adapt</strong>, particularly in a fast-paced project environment where priorities can evolve.</li> <li><strong>Attention to detail and ownership</strong>, taking pride in the quality of your work and following through on tasks.</li> <li><strong>A proactive attitude</strong>, with the confidence to ask questions, contribute ideas and get involved.</li> </ul> <p>We do not expect you to have all the answers from day one. We are looking for potential, enthusiasm and a genuine interest in developing your consulting skills while contributing to work that matters.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What's in it for you?</span></span></h3> <p>An Analyst role at Baringa is what you make it.</p> <p>This is a permanent role where you will gain real project experience alongside structured coaching, training and development. You will build your analytical, communication and problem-solving skills while learning how to support clients, work within high-performing teams and grow as a consultant.</p> <p>You will be part of a collaborative, supportive environment where you can learn from experienced consultants, explore different types of public sector work, and build a long-term career with Baringa.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Requirements</span></span></h3> <p>Applicants should have a strong academic record or equivalent experience, with an interest in consulting and public sector work. Applicants must have the permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future and be eligible for a UK Security Check (SC) clearance. All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.</p> <p>Please note we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Key dates</span></span></h3> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">Application window closes: </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">Monday 19</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun Superscript SCXW214530584 BCX8" data-fontsize="11">th</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8"> October, 12pm GMT Midday</span></span><span class="LineBreakBlob BlobObject DragDrop SCXW214530584 BCX8"><span class="SCXW214530584 BCX8">&nbsp;</span><br class="SCXW214530584 BCX8"></span><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">Assessment centres: </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">New Year 2027</span></span><span class="LineBreakBlob BlobObject DragDrop SCXW214530584 BCX8"><span class="SCXW214530584 BCX8">&nbsp;</span><br class="SCXW214530584 BCX8"></span><span class="TextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">We are looking for individuals to start with Baringa</span> May &amp; <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW214530584 BCX8">September 2027</span></span></span></span></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><br><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></h3> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="33" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="none">Generous Annual Leave Policy:</span><span data-contrast="none"> We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Graduate Analyst Programme</span></span></h3> <p>Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.</p> <p>You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.</p> <p>If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.</p> <p>We're looking for <strong>Graduate Analysts</strong> to join our <strong>Products &amp; Services</strong> practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.</p> <p>The business units currently hiring are:</p> <p><strong>Technology, Media &amp; Telecoms</strong></p> <p><strong><u>Adam to confirm</u></strong></p> <p><strong>Consumer Products &amp; Retail</strong></p> <p>Customer expectations are in flux. Commerce straddles the physical and digital worlds. Inflation is fuelling economic uncertainty. Supply chains are stretched. And sustainability is in the spotlight. In these exceptional times, we use our deep industry knowledge and pragmatic transformation experience to help consumer products and retail companies transform to remain relevant today and thrive into tomorrow. </p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis and modelling, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: Supply Chain, Business, Operations Management</em></p> <p><strong>Industrial Manufacturing</strong></p> <p>We partner with our Manufacturing clients to shape the future - securely, sustainably, and at scale. Our team bring expertise in industrial performance, operational resilience, and the transformation of complex manufacturing ecosystems. We work with leading manufacturers across automotive, aerospace &amp; defence, industrial engineering and advanced manufacturing, helping them improve performance, build resilience and deliver sustainable growth through practical, hands-on transformation.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication, Adaptability, Proactive curiosity, Interest in Manufacturing.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: </em><em>Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering</em></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">So, what's in it for you?</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll join with a cohort of our Graduate Analysts. As a cohort, you will participate in our Analyst Development Programme. Our programme is designed to develop the client, commercial and people skills that you need for a successful career at Baringa.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will join our Global Analyst Community, connecting Analysts with one another to share their experiences and lessons learnt, whilst also gaining knowledge and skills from experienced Baringa people&nbsp;</li> <li>You decide on the development you need. We invest in you, to ensure you remain the best in the business, through formal training and qualifications, coaching and mentoring.&nbsp;</li> <li>You can talk to anyone in the business. There are no barriers, and everyone is accessible, from our Analysts to our Partners. Out Partner to consultant ratio of 1:10, means you get to learn and work alongside our Directors and Partners on a daily basis.&nbsp;</li> <li>We’re proud to put people first with wellbeing at the forefront of our culture, one example of this is that every employee receives £300 a year to put towards their wellbeing!</li> <li>All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme, which seeks to ensure that everyone has a stake in the success of the company.&nbsp;</li> <li>We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break - As such we have introduced the ‘Re-charge’ benefit meaning Baringa will offer all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.&nbsp;</li> <li>Lastly, we recognise the importance of work-life balance and we know that the ‘ideal’ balance will vary from person to person and will change at different stages of our working lives.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">Requirements</span></h3> <ul> <li>Applicants must have&nbsp;the&nbsp;permanent right to work in the UK now and in the future.</li> <li>All applicants will be asked for proof if invited to an assessment centre.</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}"><u>Please note we’re unable to sponsor individuals for this opportunity.</u> &nbsp;</span></p> <h3><span style="color: #00358e;">Key dates</span></h3> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Application window closes: Monday 19<sup>th</sup> October, 12pm GMT Midday<br>Assessment centres: New Year 2027<br>We are looking for individuals to start with Baringa September 2027</span></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h2><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h2> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.</p> <p>You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.</p> <p>If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.</p> <p>We're looking for <strong>Graduate Analysts</strong> to join our <strong>Energy &amp; Resources</strong> practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.</p> <p><strong>The business units currently hiring are:</strong></p> <p><strong><u>Commodities Energy &amp; Trading</u></strong><br><br>Our commodities and energy trading focused team operates across all major commodity and energy companies in Europe, the US and Singapore. From metals traders and miners, through oil majors, freight and shipping specialists to power and gas traders. Our people bring deep industry expertise to help our clients translate strategy into action, to enter new markets, build new trading capabilities, and to revolutionize their IT landscapes. <br><br>"From day one I have worked directly with clients on their complex trading transformation journeys. This has involved face-to-face engagement with our internationally based clients, visiting client site within weeks of starting at Baringa."</p> <p><em>Desired skills: Problem solving, IT interest, data skills, interest in commodity markets, personable and confident on client site</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: </em><em>Engineering, Economics, Data science</em></p> <p><strong><u>Energy Products</u></strong></p> <p>We turn Baringa's deep energy market expertise into trusted data, insights and software products that our clients rely on as they navigate the energy transition. Our team create the market simulations and forecasts used by investors, developers, and utilities around the world to support strategic decision-making. We combine experts covering energy markets, data science, software development, and economics to create digestible data-led insight to our clients. Depending on your background you could be working with either our market research, modelling, or communications teams</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: </em><em>A keen interest in energy markets, comfortable handling large datasets and extracting insight for a wide audience, clear presentation and storytelling ability, programming (e.g. Python, SQL), using AI (for coding, for agentic workflows), experience using numerical models/simulation, interpersonal skills.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: STEM subjects, Economics, Operational Research</em></p> <p><strong><u>Markets &amp; Transactions</u></strong></p> <p>We help investors, developers, utilities, lenders and corporates make well-informed commercial decisions across the energy transition. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Graduate Analyst Programme</span></span></h3> <p>Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.</p> <p>You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.</p> <p>If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.</p> <p>We're looking for <strong>Graduate Analysts</strong> to join our <strong>Capabilities</strong> practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.</p> <p><strong>The business units currently hiring are:</strong></p> <p><strong>Customer</strong></p> <p>Imagine a world where customers are delighted, employee engagement soars and costs drop. This is the power of world-class omni-channel experiences. Our expert team anticipates change, crafting innovative solutions that blend seamlessly across all touchpoints. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we transform service delivery, minimising costs while maximising impact. Ready to enhance your market position and unlock unprecedented value? Let’s redefine excellence together.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Strong communication, teamwork, and relationship-building skills. Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking. A customer-focused mindset and interest in improving customer experiences. AI and digital literacy with a curiosity for emerging technologies. Adaptability, curiosity, and a proactive approach to learning and development.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: Business Management, Product Design UX &amp; UI, and Marketing</em></p> <p><strong>Enterprise Value Creation</strong></p> <p>Every organisation faces moments when it needs to grow faster, operate more efficiently or respond to changing market conditions. Baringa's Enterprise Value Creation team helps clients navigate these challenges by combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, AI-native mindset, and practical delivery expertise. We advise executive leadership teams to identify opportunities, solve complex business problems and deliver sustainable improvements in growth, profitability, and performance.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication, Adaptability, Commercial and financial curiosity.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: Open to all degree types.</em></p> <p><strong>Organisation, People &amp; Change </strong></p> <p>Organisation, People, and Change (OPC) enables organisations to achieve lasting success by putting people at the centre of transformation. With a holistic approach, our team helps clients align their operating models, people strategies, structures, and cultures with their strategic ambitions. OPC ensures organisations are equipped to deliver impact that lasts through an engaged and high-performing workforce.</p> <p>As part of OPC, you will have the opportunity to work across a range of sectors, helping clients with a range of solutions:</p> <ul> <li>Optimising operations and organisational design: Align business capabilities, processes, and technology with the strategic ambition to drive efficiency and effectiveness.</li> <li>Unlocking leadership, culture, and workforce potential: Shape future skills, foster an engaged and high-performing workforce, and embed target cultures through people-led experiences.</li> <li>Crafting and delivering transformation and change strategies: Define the vision, strategic direction, and OKRs to create positive conditions for change, enabling organisations to deliver lasting impact.</li> </ul> <p><em>Desired Skills: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, Organisation and project management capability, Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset, AI literacy and an interest in innovation, A genuine passion for consulting and transforming organisations and workforces through meaningful change.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees (not essential): Business management / Management and Organisational Behaviour, Psychology / Organisational Psychology, Engineering - critical thinking / problem solving, Data Analytics / Business Analytics.</em></p> <p><strong>Supply Chain &amp; Procurement </strong></p> <p>The SCP team helps organisations tackle complex challenges across their supply chains, procurement functions and commercial operations. Working with clients across the public and private sectors, we help organisations navigate an increasingly uncertain world, responding to challenges such as cost pressures, supply chain disruption, changing customer expectations and rapid technological change.</p> <p>As part of SCP, you'll work on a diverse range of projects spanning supply chain strategy, procurement transformation, commercial advisory, logistics, and technology-enabled change, as part of either our Supply Chain or Procurement &amp; Commercial practice. Our teams combine analytical thinking, practical problem-solving and deep industry expertise to help clients create efficient, resilient and sustainable organisations that deliver lasting value.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Team collaboration and effective communication, Adaptability and personal resilience, Proactive curiosity, Digital literacy.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: No degree preference, analytical capabilities are key. If you have commercial acumen this is a bonus. Candidates may benefit from STEM experience, but this is not a requirement.</em></p> <p><strong>Data, AI, Solutions &amp; Engineering</strong></p> <p>Expertly applied, data and AI empower you to operate smarter, innovate faster and compete harder. Blending exceptional technical skills with deep industry knowledge, our consultants make the possibilities real. We are experts in crafting practical data and AI solutions and integrating these into existing production workflows. Where data and AI requires new scalable technology, we work with you to establish the case for investment. And when new data insights are revealed, we ensure you have the right talent to unlock full value. Whether you are looking to establish a robust data infrastructure, foster a data-driven culture or ensure data and information security and compliance are maintained, we can help.</p> <p><em>Desired Skills: Problem Solving, Data Analysis, Data Literacy, Technical Data Skills - BI, Python, Engineering, ML, Other coding languages.</em></p> <p><em>Desired Degrees: STEM, Computer Science, Data Science, Other technical data/AI degrees</em></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">So, what's in it for you?</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>You’ll join with a cohort of our Graduate Analysts. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

CRM at Neko is a newer but critical function, and this role exists to define its strategy and turn it into one of the company's core growth engines. You will be accountable for the CRM outcomes that matter most as we bring proactive, preventive healthcare to billions of people: converting leads and the waitlist into booked scans and bringing members back for their next scan and their next referral.

This isn't stewarding an established machine. You will set the vision, the operating model, and the investment case, scale the implementation of our CRM platform and practices across markets, and build the organization that delivers it – to the same standard of excellence and care our clinics deliver in person.

You will lead through others, building and directing a multi-market team, and work with Marketing, Comms, and Product, alongside other business functions. You will influence executive decisions on growth and be accountable for CRM's financial contribution to the business.

In the early months, you will be close to the work: operating the platform, shaping test briefs and making content calls alongside the team, while you hire the people to take on more of the day-to-day work.

You will report to the Senior Director of Growth.

Where we are today

CRM at Neko is at an early stage. Today the function is a small team running email and SMS, with the potential to implement and optimize the right messaging at every stage. We are currently implementing Braze over Q4 2026.

Neko is also scaling after its US launch – a key market for Neko, with CRM being a key factor in our success here. You will join while the foundations are being laid, with the mandate to shape them.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 months

  • Set the long-term CRM strategy: define a multi-market vision and roadmap across acquisition, conversion, and retention, with investment cases and success measures agreed with Growth leadership.

  • Own the growth outcomes: be accountable for CRM's measurable contribution to bookings, rebooking, referral, and revenue, with baselines set and targets agreed with senior leadership.

  • Design CRM as one coherent program: nurture, lifecycle, and re-engagement working together across every live channel, with performance visible at each funnel stage.

  • Scale CRM for the US and beyond: build a repeatable playbook for new cities and markets, including regional compliance and localization.

  • Make test-and-learn the standard: set the experimentation framework and ensure results change decisions.

  • Build the organization: hire the first layer of the CRM function, creating a high-performing team, including leads and managers, define the structure by region, channel or lifecycle stage, and grow future leaders.

Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

The FF+E Design Lead will own the development and stewardship of Neko Health’s global furniture, fixtures, equipment, and accessories strategy — defining the physical objects, materials, and product selections that shape the member experience across every Neko location worldwide.

Working within the Architecture Creative Leads team, this role sits at the intersection of interior design, physical user experience, and procurement strategy. Your primary focus is establishing a scalable, globally consistent FF+E standard that ensures every Neko space feels considered, cohesive, and unmistakably Neko.

You will develop FF+E and accessories standards for the Location Design Playbook, drive product development and selection and provide concept-level creative guidance to regional design teams delivering projects globally.

This role reports to the Architecture Creative Studio Lead and partners closely with the Architecture Design Studio Leads for the US and Europe, the Industrial Design Lead, and cross-functional teams in Hardware, Operations, Brand, and Procurement.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Comprehensive global standards, documented in the Location Design Playbook — covering furniture, fixtures, accessories, for all key clinic zones — with clear specifications, product lists, and sourcing guidance ready for regional teams to implement.

  • A scalable procurement and vendor strategy for FF+E, with preferred suppliers identified globally and regionally, supporting consistent quality, cost efficiency, and lead-time reliability across markets.

  • Concept-level FF+E guidance on at least two active regional projects, ensuring selections align with Neko’s design language and experience principles while adapting to local availability and requirements.

  • Contribute to the development of bespoke FF+E and accessory items that cannot be sourced off-the-shelf — collaborating with the Industrial Design Lead and external vendors to develop proprietary solutions that reinforce the Neko brand.

Minimum Requirements

  • Degree in Interior Design, Product Design, Furniture Design, Industrial Design, Architecture, or related field.

  • 8+ years of experience in FF+E design, specification, and procurement, with a portfolio demonstrating a strong eye for material quality, detail, and cohesive design language.

  • Demonstrated experience developing FF+E standards, product libraries, or specification playbooks for a multi-site, global or scaling organization.

  • A keen eye for colour, material and finishes.

  • Deep understanding of bespoke furniture and product manufacturing methods — materials, finishes, construction methods, durability and sustainability considerations.

  • Experience managing vendor relationships and procurement processes, including sourcing, sampling, cost negotiation and quality control across multiple markets.

  • Strong understanding of ergonomics, accessibility, and relevant product safety and compliance standards within a commercial retail environment.

  • Excellent communication skills — able to articulate design intent and product rationale to both creative and operational audiences, and comfortable presenting to leadership.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, scaling environment where standards are still being built and processes are evolving.

  • Alignment with Neko’s studio culture: enablers not heroes, creative problem solvers, craft-driven.

Preferred

  • Experience crafting environments where furniture and fixtures play a direct role in customer experience.

  • Familiarity with branded retail, hospitality, or experiential environments at scale — where FF+E consistency is critical to brand expression.

  • Experience developing bespoke or custom-manufactured furniture and accessory products from concept through production.

  • Knowledge of sustainability and circular design principles in product selection — lifecycle analysis, material health, and responsible sourcing.

title: Senior Recruiting Coordinator
description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a Senior Recruiting Coordinator to our team. In this position, you will play a critical role in creating a thoughtful, organized, and high-quality recruiting experience from the first candidate interaction through the interview process. You will partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to coordinate interviews, manage candidate communications and logistics, and keep the hiring process moving. Our Senior Recruiting Coordinators play an important role in shaping how candidates experience CesiumAstro. For many candidates, you will be one of their first interactions with the company and one of the first faces they meet onsite. How we communicate, how prepared we are, and how we show up throughout the process matters. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of those details and represents our culture with professionalism, urgency, and care. This is a fast moving role that requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, and strong communication. The ideal candidate is a true team player who can quickly understand business needs, stay ahead of competing priorities, and take pride in delivering a high quality experience for candidates and internal teams alike   JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and CesiumAstro staff, ensuring a positive experience for all parties. Manage job postings on various platforms, including the company website and external job boards. This will include drafting job postings and other recruitment-related materials as well as posting and maintaining job listings on state job boards in alignment with Affirmative Action (AA) and compliance guidelines. Maintain and update the applicant tracking system (ATS) with candidate information and status updates. Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely updates. Support the onboarding process by conducting pre-employment background checks, drug screens, and coordinating start dates.   Pull reports on recruitment metrics through our ATS, Lever. Collaborate with the recruitment team on candidate experience. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Associate's degree or equivalent relevant experience. Minimum of 5 years of experience in recruiting or related business administration. Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc., and familiarity with ATS systems (Lever preferred). Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment. A positive attitude, team-oriented, and a passion for recruitment. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. A high level of integrity and respect for confidentiality. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Passion for the space industry. Experience working in a start-up or small company. Experience at high-tech companies. CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organisation. Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees. description: They do 08/15. We create 9:16 Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren. Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung. WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung – als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als Senior Creative Strategist (all genders) . Du verbindest strategische Klarheit mit kreativer Führung. Als strategische Stimme von WeCreate entwickelst du die Marken- und Plattformlogik unserer Kund:innen, übersetzt sie in wirksame Content-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten Idee ein konsistenter, relevanter und plattformnativer Content-Output wird. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest die strategische und kreative Gesamtausrichtung komplexer Kunden-Mandate von der Social Marken-Positionierung über Plattform- und Kanalstrategien bis zur übergreifenden Content-Systematik und Qualitätssicherung über alle Projektphasen hinweg. Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig auf Senior-Level, triffst Entscheidungen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und kommunizierst sicher mit den Marken-Entscheider:innen. Du führst Creative Reviews, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und gibst Kund:innen sowie internen Teams Orientierung, wenn strategische, kreative oder operative Fragen zusammenkommen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der integrierten Arbeit mit dem Team: Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat arbeitest du im WeCreate-Office in Hamburg. Zusätzlich bringst du die notwendige Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate mit auch dann, wenn diese außerhalb deines üblichen Arbeitsortes stattfinden. Dein Impact bei WeCreate Du gibst Marken und Teams Richtung. Du sorgst dafür, dass strategische Klarheit nicht in Präsentationen endet, sondern in kreativen Systemen, relevanten Inhalten und konsistenter Markenwirkung sichtbar wird. Du verbindest die Perspektiven von Kund:innen, Creative Studio, Beratung, Produktion und Plattformen. Dabei bist du mehr als Ideengeber:in. Du entwickelst die Logik hinter der Arbeit, führst durch komplexe Entscheidungen und stellst sicher, dass Qualität über alle Projektphasen hinweg erkennbar bleibt. Als Senior Creative Strategist stärkst du nicht nur einzelne Kundenprojekte, sondern auch die strategische und kreative Kompetenz von WeCreate als Organisation. Das erwartet dich: Strategische und kreative Gesamtverantwortung: Du führst komplexe Kunden-Mandate ganzheitlich von digitaler Markenpositionierung, Plattform- und Kanalstrategie bis zur kreativen Leitidee und belastbaren Umsetzungslogik. Seniorige Kunden- und Teamführung: Du präsentierst Strategien und Kreativkonzepte überzeugend, moderierst Sparrings-Formate und führst interdisziplinäre Teams zu klaren, tragfähigen Entscheidungen. Creative Strategy und Narrative Systems: Du entwickelst kulturell relevante Leitideen, Narrative und Content-Systeme, die über Plattformen, Formate und Touchpoints hinweg funktionieren. Qualitäts- und Entscheidungsführung: Du sicherst die strategische und kreative Qualität von der Aufgabenstellung bis zum finalen Output, gibst präzises Feedback und erkennst früh, wenn Idee, Marke und Plattformlogik auseinanderlaufen. Playbooks, Standards und fachliches Sparring: Du entwickelst verbindliche Leitplanken für das Creative Studio und bist ein:e erfahrene:r Sparringspartner:in für Kund:innen sowie Creative-, Strategy- und Beratungsteams. Coaching und Wissensaufbau: Du teilst dein Wissen aktiv, coachst Kolleg:innen und stärkst nicht nur einzelne Arbeiten, sondern auch die strategische und kreative Arbeitsweise des Teams. Systemische Zusammenarbeit und Weiterentwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit Social-, Creator-, Community-, Production- und Paid-Teams zusammen, begleitest relevante Produktionen und Offsites und entwickelst interne Prozesse sowie KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen weiter. Dafür bringst du Reise- und Terminflexibilität mit. Das bringst du mit: Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Herausforderungen in klare strategische Positionierungen, kreative Leitideen und umsetzbare Content-Systeme übersetzen. Du hast Erfahrung in der strategischen und kreativen Gesamtverantwortung für anspruchsvolle Kunden-Mandate, Kampagnen oder Markenaufgaben. Du kannst Plattform- und Kanalstrategien entwickeln und mit einer übergreifenden Content-Systematik verbinden. Du präsentierst komplexe Strategien sicher vor Entscheider:innen und auf C-Level und kannst unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu klaren Entscheidungen führen. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Content, Plattformkultur und gesellschaftliche sowie kulturelle Signale. Du kannst kreative Qualität über Konzept, Briefing, Produktion und finalen Output hinweg sichern und Feedback präzise, konstruktiv und verbindlich formulieren. Du hast Erfahrung darin, Playbooks, Standards oder Leitplanken zu entwickeln und Wissen in Teams wirksam zu vermitteln. So arbeitest du Du denkst strategisch und kreativ zugleich und verlierst dabei weder die Marke noch die Plattform oder die Umsetzbarkeit aus dem Blick. Du triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und schaffst Orientierung, wenn Anforderungen komplex oder noch nicht vollständig geklärt sind. Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch. Du arbeitest gerne integriert mit anderen Disziplinen und weißt, dass die beste Arbeit selten am eigenen Schreibtisch entsteht. Du bist bereit, mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat im Hamburger Office zu arbeiten und für Produktionen, Workshops sowie Offsite-Formate flexibel vor Ort teilzunehmen. Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu coachen und strategische sowie kreative Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln. Das bekommst du bei uns: Flexibilität mit Verbindung Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine Arbeitsweise, die zu deinem Alltag passt Freie Wahl deiner Hardware Benefits, die dir wirklich etwas bringen Gemeinsame Events und Workations, weil gute Zusammenarbeit nicht nur im Kalender entsteht Wahlweise Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Probonio-Gutschein oder Urban Sports Club Bagel-Frühstück im Office für einen gemeinsamen Start in den Tag Und sonst? Kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen in deine Expertise Eine steile Lernkurve – ohne Dauer-Überstunden als vermeintliches Karriereprogramm Raum, eine wachsende Agentur und unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten Flache Hierarchien sowie ein respektvoller, offener Umgang miteinander Hinweis zur Anstellung: Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet – mit Option auf Verlängerung bzw. Dans un environnement à forte accélération sur la Data et l’IA Générative, vous intervenez pour piloter des projets d'ingénierie complexes, encadrer les équipes et porter l'excellence opérationnelle et technique.</p> <p><strong>Ce qu’on attend de vous :</strong></p> <p>En tant que Manager, vous supervisez la conception et le déploiement d'architectures critiques (Data Platforms, Agentic Platforms) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement de carrières des membres de l'équipe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la relation client, le cadrage technique des affaires et le rayonnement de la communauté tech Artefact.</p> <p><strong>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Piloter et encadrer la réalisation de projets Data &amp; IA complexes (ex. solutions multi-agents LangGraph sur Kubernetes, architectures Médaillon).</li> <li>Superviser le cadrage et la construction de Data Platforms robustes sur GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake en garantissant l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et d'ingénierie logicielle.</li> <li>Définir la vision technique des projets GenAI / LLM (orchestration, évaluation, contrôle) et promouvoir l'usage quotidien des coding agents au sein des équipes.</li> <li>Assurer la gestion de carrière, le suivi de performance et le mentoring continu des Software Engineers sous votre responsabilité.</li> <li>Mener les cadrages techniques auprès des clients grands comptes et défendre avec pédagogie les choix stratégiques et d'architecture.</li> <li>Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de code, de sécurité et de livrables sur l'ensemble de vos périmètres applicatifs.</li> <li>Contribuer activement à l'animation de la communauté technique (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX) et participer au processus de recrutement et de montée en compétences de la pratique.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience &amp; Leadership :</strong> Expérience confirmée en tant que Lead / Engineering Manager ou Senior Architect ayant déjà encadré des équipes techniques et piloté des projets stratégiques.</li> <li><strong>Résolution de problèmes :</strong> Solides intuitions techniques et capacité à traduire des enjeux business complexes en architectures techniques pérennes.</li> <li><strong>Management &amp; Transmission :</strong> Posture bienveillante, pédagogique et exemplaire, à l'aise pour faire grandir les talents, donner du feedback constructif et animer une équipe.</li> <li><strong>Spécialisations (au moins 1) :</strong> Expertise avérée en Analytics Engineering, Software Development, SRE, Cloud Architecture ou AI Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Stack technique :</strong> Maîtrise avancée de l'écosystème tech (Python, FastAPI, dbt, LangGraph, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process de recrutement :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>HR Interview (30-45 min) :</strong> Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.</li> <li><strong>Technical Deep Dive (60 min) :</strong> Session de live coding et d'architecture system design avec un Senior Engineering Lead basé en France.</li> <li><strong>US / Manager Interview (60 min) :</strong> Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Rémunération :</strong> Package :&nbsp; 75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.</p> <p><strong>Présentation de l’entreprise</strong></p> <p>Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.</p> <p>A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.</p> <p>Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : <a href="https://www.artefact.com/">https://www.artefact.com</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> <p><br><br><br></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <p>At Datadog, Batch Engineering owns something most engineers only dream about: a domain. Most backend engineers work in one or the other; you'd own both end-to-end.</p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. description: <p><strong>Présentation du poste :</strong></p> <p>Au sein de l’équipe technique d’Artefact, vous rejoignez une communauté de Software Engineers en tant que Manager et référent technique auprès de nos grands comptes clients. Dans un environnement à forte accélération sur la Data et l’IA Générative, vous intervenez pour piloter des projets d'ingénierie complexes, encadrer les équipes et porter l'excellence opérationnelle et technique.</p> <p><strong>Ce qu’on attend de vous :</strong></p> <p>En tant que Manager, vous supervisez la conception et le déploiement d'architectures critiques (Data Platforms, Agentic Platforms) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement de carrières des membres de l'équipe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la relation client, le cadrage technique des affaires et le rayonnement de la communauté tech Artefact.</p> <p><strong>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Piloter et encadrer la réalisation de projets Data &amp; IA complexes (ex. solutions multi-agents LangGraph sur Kubernetes, architectures Médaillon).</li> <li>Superviser le cadrage et la construction de Data Platforms robustes sur GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake en garantissant l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et d'ingénierie logicielle.</li> <li>Définir la vision technique des projets GenAI / LLM (orchestration, évaluation, contrôle) et promouvoir l'usage quotidien des coding agents au sein des équipes.</li> <li>Assurer la gestion de carrière, le suivi de performance et le mentoring continu des Software Engineers sous votre responsabilité.</li> <li>Mener les cadrages techniques auprès des clients grands comptes et défendre avec pédagogie les choix stratégiques et d'architecture.</li> <li>Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de code, de sécurité et de livrables sur l'ensemble de vos périmètres applicatifs.</li> <li>Contribuer activement à l'animation de la communauté technique (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX) et participer au processus de recrutement et de montée en compétences de la pratique.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience &amp; Leadership :</strong> Expérience confirmée en tant que Lead / Engineering Manager ou Senior Architect ayant déjà encadré des équipes techniques et piloté des projets stratégiques.</li> <li><strong>Résolution de problèmes :</strong> Solides intuitions techniques et capacité à traduire des enjeux business complexes en architectures techniques pérennes.</li> <li><strong>Management &amp; Transmission :</strong> Posture bienveillante, pédagogique et exemplaire, à l'aise pour faire grandir les talents, donner du feedback constructif et animer une équipe.</li> <li><strong>Spécialisations (au moins 1) :</strong> Expertise avérée en Analytics Engineering, Software Development, SRE, Cloud Architecture ou AI Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Stack technique :</strong> Maîtrise avancée de l'écosystème tech (Python, FastAPI, dbt, LangGraph, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process de recrutement :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>HR Interview (30-45 min) :</strong> Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.</li> <li><strong>Technical Deep Dive (60 min) :</strong> Session de live coding et d'architecture system design avec un Senior Engineering Lead basé en France.</li> <li><strong>US / Manager Interview (60 min) :</strong> Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Rémunération :</strong> Package :&nbsp; 75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.</p> <p><strong>Présentation de l’entreprise</strong></p> <p>Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.</p> <p>A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.</p> <p>Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : <a href="https://www.artefact.com/">https://www.artefact.com</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> <p><br><br><br></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Web Compatibility Engineer
description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the latest — Privacy Pro . Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include: Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer , you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo. About You 7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript. Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python. Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases. Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause. Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact. Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience shipping code beyond the web, like native or desktop clients. Ability to lead complex, ambiguous projects with little to no oversight. Compensation $178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is identical within professional levels , regardless of geographic location or team. Compensation for each professional level is transparent across the organization. Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK. Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances. Hiring Process Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire . Diversity, Equity and Inclusion DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants , and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws. We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to Please note that: You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend. While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week. A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team. By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work. Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process. Key Principles: Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy . We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes. Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors. Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at Compensation: $178.5K • Offers Equity Annual Compensation • Annual Compensation $178.5K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

  • Excellent communication skills at storytelling level across different seniorities and cultures

raw.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

 

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

 

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

 

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

This role will lead the technical orchestration of a major client program, partnering with an international energy retailer in their operational transformation. You will oversee the migration’s technical pillar and manage the ongoing technical relationship, supporting the client’s adoption of our Kraken platform as part of their broader business transformation.

 

We work incredibly dynamically, and this role is one that will take different shapes throughout the week. We are looking for well rounded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity, are self-starters and willing to roll their sleeves up to get to the nitty gritty of a problem. You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing senior stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Building trusted relationships with client executives and technology stakeholders, including partnering with our product and engineering teams to align on priorities. Serving as the escalation point for client concerns and ensuring both technical challenges and product requirements are effectively managed

  • Defining success criteria and governance for delivering the technical pillar of the program. 

  • Owning the Kraken platform localisation plan to meet client expectations while matching Kraken roadmap

  •  Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines, etc internally as structured input for the successful and timely execution of any required technology platform localisation and development.

  • Directing internal Kraken software developers contributing to the client program, as well as potential external Partners, on tech platform deliverables to ensure  an overall successful and timely  technology migration.

  • Supporting the client meets their business needs via the delivery of tech. 

  • Understanding the Kraken infrastructure, aligning client direction with the overall goal for the Kraken platform & business. 

  • Setting up training programs to upskill the technical arm of the client. 

  • Being an advocate for the Kraken way of delivering tech and supporting the client in shifting their mindset around tech delivery

 

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Communication: You need to be confident in calling out approaches that aren't best for the client and always striving for simplicity.  You need to be able to communicate the context behind decisions relating to the platform & client priorities. You must be able to build strong relationships and credibility amongst senior stakeholders, balancing the needs of the client with Kraken’s business needs and platform potential and constraints.   

  • Program management: Confident in managing a long term, fast paced program. Can be both high level and dive into detail when required. Ability to directly manage a team and manage processes that can drive the right outcomes for clients. 

  • Strong technical aptitude: We are looking for a logical thinker who has strong problem solving skills within an agile working framework. Must quickly be able to grasp the technical capabilities and constraints of the Kraken platform. Is an advocate for the continuous deployment approach we take at Kraken and champions building tech iteratively. 

  • Business acumen: Able to understand business goals of both client and Kraken, putting all technology decisions into context to ensure measurable success can be achieved and celebrated.

  • You are based in Paris, France and willing to travel internationally

Experience / Qualifications needed:

  • Technical mindset, experience in engineering-led industries 

  • Sector-relevant experience in managing complex technology implementation or migration programs

  • Proven experience in software adaptation, deployment and integration

Dans un environnement à forte accélération sur la Data et l’IA Générative, vous intervenez pour piloter des projets d'ingénierie complexes, encadrer les équipes et porter l'excellence opérationnelle et technique.</p> <p><strong>Ce qu’on attend de vous :</strong></p> <p>En tant que Manager, vous supervisez la conception et le déploiement d'architectures critiques (Data Platforms, Agentic Platforms) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement de carrières des membres de l'équipe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la relation client, le cadrage technique des affaires et le rayonnement de la communauté tech Artefact.</p> <p><strong>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Piloter et encadrer la réalisation de projets Data &amp; IA complexes (ex. solutions multi-agents LangGraph sur Kubernetes, architectures Médaillon).</li> <li>Superviser le cadrage et la construction de Data Platforms robustes sur GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake en garantissant l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et d'ingénierie logicielle.</li> <li>Définir la vision technique des projets GenAI / LLM (orchestration, évaluation, contrôle) et promouvoir l'usage quotidien des coding agents au sein des équipes.</li> <li>Assurer la gestion de carrière, le suivi de performance et le mentoring continu des Software Engineers sous votre responsabilité.</li> <li>Mener les cadrages techniques auprès des clients grands comptes et défendre avec pédagogie les choix stratégiques et d'architecture.</li> <li>Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de code, de sécurité et de livrables sur l'ensemble de vos périmètres applicatifs.</li> <li>Contribuer activement à l'animation de la communauté technique (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX) et participer au processus de recrutement et de montée en compétences de la pratique.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience &amp; development and expansion within existing customers.</li> <li value="2">Ability to run a consultative sales process, from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and closing.</li> <li
